dc_eval_cbrn.quote: We can rule out the TCL for the CBRN domain with reasonable confidence based on the results from our testing.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash reaches the alert threshold for this CCL, but not the CCL itself.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash can complete individual coding tasks but lacks the independence to chain them into an end-to-end research workflow without human intervention.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: ML R&D acceleration/automation CCLs not reached.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash demonstrates some ability to influence user beliefs and behaviors during one-on-one direct conversations in human behavioural studies.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash is observant enough to correctly assess when it is in a testing environment, but it cannot successfully bypass testing restrictions.
dc_eval_scheming.locator: Frontier Safety Assessment, ML R&D and Misalignment
dc_eval_scheming.note: Stealth and situational awareness results, TCL not reached.
